items.title: Drag to collapse keeps going
items.text: Dragging a divider past a pane's minimum now collapses the next pane, and the one after it, as the drag continues. Dragging back brings them out again in reverse, in the same drag.

items.title: New drop targets for strips
items.text: When you drag a minimized strip, you can drop it between any cards or strips in its row, at a window's edge, or at a screen's edge. A screen edge opens the pane in a new window tiled to that half of the screen. Dropping a strip on a pane no longer splits or swaps. Each target shows a preview.

items.title: Resizers stay in the gutters
items.text: Dividers, stack grips and the sidebar edge only take the mouse in the gaps between panes. They no longer cover a pane's drag handle or its edge.

items.title: Strips stay put
items.text: Focusing a pane that's already on show never shuffles the row. Undo, stash, closing a viewer and switching windows no longer bring strips back out or put the caret on one. A pane dropped on a strip stays minimized there.

items.title: Viewers no longer go blank
items.text: HTML pages, websites, markdown, code, images and diffs now show reliably in hero mode, and again when you leave it. Before, a viewer could show a blank page in hero mode about half the time.
